reload.note: Speed of loading. The size of the effect is a guess.

drill.note: Speed of manoeuvre: trained troops changed formation faster and raw ones slower (Nafziger and Muir, from memory). The size of the effect is a guess.

melee.note: Weight in a close fight. The size of the effect is a guess.

rally.unit: multiplier on morale recovery when routed
rally.note: Readiness to rally. The size of the effect is a guess.
